title: Prepare Your Job Application Kit
description: Create a complete job application package: resume, cover letter, LinkedIn profile, and practice interview answers
objective: Students will create a professional resume PDF, write a tailored cover letter, optimize their LinkedIn profile, and prepare answers for common interview questions

steps.title: Create Your Resume
steps.instructions:
Use a clean template (Google Docs, Canva, or plain text in VS Code).

Follow this structure:

```
YOUR NAME
Phone | Email | LinkedIn | GitHub | Portfolio

SUMMARY
2 lines: who you are + top skills + what you're looking for

SKILLS
Languages: Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL
Frameworks: FastAPI, Django, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS
Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Docker, Postman, Figma
Soft Skills: Problem Solving, Team Collaboration, Communication

PROJECTS
1. Student Management API | FastAPI, SQLite
   - Built a REST API with 5 CRUD endpoints and Pydantic validation
   - Deployed to Render with environment-based configuration
   - GitHub: link | Live: link

2. Portfolio Website | HTML, Tailwind CSS
   - Designed and built a responsive portfolio with 4 project showcases
   - Achieved 90+ Lighthouse score on performance and accessibility
   - Live: link

3. Expense Analyzer | Python, Pandas, Matplotlib
   - Created a data analysis tool that reads CSV and generates 3 chart types
   - Processed 100+ expense records with category-wise breakdowns

EDUCATION
Advanced Diploma in Computer Applications (ADCA) | TechPath Institute | 2026
[Degree] | [College] | [Year]

CERTIFICATIONS (if any)
- freeCodeCamp: Responsive Web Design
- HackerRank: Python (Basic)
```

Export as PDF: `YourName_Resume.pdf`

Proofread checklist:
- [ ] No spelling errors
- [ ] No "I" statements
- [ ] Action verbs used (Built, Developed, Deployed)
- [ ] Fits on 1 page
- [ ] Phone number and email are correct

steps.title: Write a Cover Letter Template
steps.instructions:
Create a template you can customize for each application:

```
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. 
As a recent ADCA graduate from TechPath Institute with hands-on experience 
in Python, FastAPI, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity 
to contribute to your team.

During my training, I built [number] real-world projects including 
[Project Name], a [brief description]. This project involved [tech stack] 
and taught me [skill]. I also [another achievement].

I am particularly interested in [Company Name] because [specific reason — 
their product, mission, technology]. I believe my skills in [relevant skills] 
align well with what you're looking for.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team. 
Please find my resume attached.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Phone] | [Email] | [Portfolio URL]
```

Save as `CoverLetter_Template.md`.

For each application, change: Company Name, Job Title, and the "particularly interested" paragraph.

steps.title: Optimize LinkedIn Profile
steps.instructions:
Log into LinkedIn and update:

1. **Headline:** "Full Stack Developer | Python | FastAPI | HTML/CSS/JS | Open to Opportunities"

2. **About (Summary):**
```
Recent ADCA graduate from TechPath Institute with hands-on experience 
building web applications and REST APIs. Skilled in Python, FastAPI, 
JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and SQL. Built 6 real-world projects during 
training including a deployed Student Management API and a responsive 
portfolio website.

Looking for opportunities where I can apply my full-stack development 
skills and grow as a developer.

Open to: Full-time roles, Internships, Freelance projects
Skills: Python, FastAPI, Django, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, Git
```

3. **Custom URL:** linkedin.com/in/yourname (Settings → Edit public profile URL)

4. **Add projects:** Each with description, tech stack, and links

5. **Add skills:** Python, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, Git

6. **Ask 2-3 batchmates** to endorse your skills

Screenshot your completed profile.

steps.title: Practice Interview Questions
steps.instructions:
Write answers to these 10 questions (50-100 words each):

1. **Tell me about yourself.** (Use the 30-second pitch)
2. **What is your strongest technical skill?** (Give an example project)
3. **Explain REST API to a non-technical person.**
4. **What's the difference between Python list and dictionary?**
5. **How do you make a website responsive?**
6. **Describe a project you're proud of. What challenges did you face?**
7. **What is Git and why is version control important?**
8. **How do you stay updated with new technologies?**
9. **Where do you see yourself in 2 years?**
10. **Why should we hire you?**

Practice:
- Read your answers out loud 3 times
- Time your "Tell me about yourself" — should be under 60 seconds
- Record yourself on your phone and watch it back
- Practice with a batchmate — take turns asking each other

steps.title: Apply to 3 Real Opportunities
steps.instructions:
Put your job kit into action:

1. **Find 3 job listings** on any of these platforms:
   - Internshala (internshala.com) — internships
   - LinkedIn Jobs — entry-level developer roles
   - Naukri.com — IT jobs in your city

2. **For each job, prepare:**
   - Customize the cover letter (change company name, why you're interested)
   - Check that your resume matches the job requirements
   - Note which of your projects are most relevant

3. **Apply to all 3** (yes, actually apply!)

4. **Document your applications:**

```markdown
## Job Applications Log

### Application 1
- Company: [Name]
- Role: [Title]
- Platform: [Internshala/LinkedIn/Naukri]
- Date Applied: [Date]
- Why this role: [1 sentence]
- Relevant projects: [Which of your projects match]

### Application 2
...
```

Save this as `applications.md`.

Tips for first-time applicants:
- Apply to internships first (lower bar, great learning)
- Don't wait to be "ready" — apply now and learn from the process
- Follow up after 1 week if no response
- Track every application in a spreadsheet

**Submit:** Resume PDF + Cover Letter + LinkedIn URL + 10 interview answers + `applications.md` with 3 real applications.

expected_output: A complete job application kit: professional 1-page resume PDF, customizable cover letter template, optimized LinkedIn profile, and prepared answers for 10 common interview questions
